metadata.purpose: Test expert patterns against YOUR 9 validated scenarios

scenarios.name: Multi-sentence complex objection
scenarios.transcript: I've been thinking about this extensively. We've had bad experiences with similar solutions in the past. The implementation was a nightmare and took months longer than promised. I'm just not convinced this time will be different.
scenarios.your_reasoning: Multiple strong negatives + late stage (7) + deep skepticism = strongest defusal tool

scenarios.name: Implied stakeholder concern
scenarios.transcript: That's an interesting perspective on how to handle the situation. We'll need to discuss this with the broader team before making any decisions.
scenarios.your_reasoning: Soft objection disguised as process. Validate first, then explore with Empathy Questions

scenarios.name: Deep frustration with past failures
scenarios.transcript: Every solution we've tried has fallen short. The team is tired of false promises. I don't have the energy to go through another failed implementation.
scenarios.your_reasoning: Stage 4 + strong emotional exhaustion = Labeling (NOT Take Away - too early)

scenarios.name: Mixed signals with timing concerns
scenarios.transcript: On one hand, I see the potential value. On the other hand, we're already stretched thin with current projects. I want to move forward but the timing feels off.
scenarios.your_reasoning: BUYING SIGNAL - 'I see value' + 'want to move forward' BUT timing concern = Mirror to explore

scenarios.name: Stakeholder politics
scenarios.transcript: The executive team has been pushing for innovation, but there's resistance from middle management who are comfortable with the status quo. Navigating that dynamic is tricky.
scenarios.your_reasoning: STRONGEST BUYING SIGNAL - Execs want it, just needs help with middle mgmt. Mirror 'status quo' to explore

scenarios.name: Emotional escalation
scenarios.transcript: This is the third time we've had this conversation and I feel like we're going in circles. I'm starting to question if we're even aligned on what success looks like here.
scenarios.your_reasoning: Frustration with stuck progress (NOT hostility). Use Negative Assumption to reset conversation

scenarios.name: Risk aversion without explicit objection
scenarios.transcript: We're in a critical growth phase right now. Any disruption to our current operations could have significant downstream effects on our customer commitments.
scenarios.your_reasoning: Vague/generic concern. Need specifics. Mirror 'critical growth' or use Empathy Questions

scenarios.name: Enthusiasm with hesitation
scenarios.transcript: This is exactly what we've been looking for. The features align perfectly with our needs. My only concern is whether we can get executive approval given budget constraints this quarter.
scenarios.your_reasoning: BUYING SIGNAL - High enthusiasm + approval concern. Mirror 'budget constraints' to explore OR use Calibrated Questions

scenarios.name: Indirect rejection
scenarios.transcript: Let me take this back to the team and see what they think. We'll circle back once we've had a chance to digest everything and discuss internally.
scenarios.your_reasoning: Late stage stall tactic. Use Labeling to call out Black Swan OR Take Away to end it
